asked_by: Madhav, 29 Oct 2026 (the reverse-engineering plan: 'indicator combinations, verify the top 1-2%'; done as agreed in the blueprint: bounded families with a reason, small grids, plateaus, consistency, a trial penalty and a negative control, not a search over millions)
title: The combination lab: does a stock setup together with a market state earn more over 20 sessions than the better of the two alone? Five stock setups x five market states on the random (ANY) entries, 2000-2023
hypothesis: For each pair, trades signalled while BOTH the stock setup and the market state are on earn more over the next 20 sessions (net) than trades signalled while the better of the two is on by itself (the interaction), within quarters, in both periods. A random stock flag with the same frequency paired with the same market state earns nothing in particular.
why_it_might_work: Each stock setup is a found or plausible single effect (oversold RSI, not extended, a healthy pullback, high delivery, a 60-session washout) and each market state changes who is buying (trend, breadth washout, fear, small-cap leadership, a breadth thrust); the textbook claim is that the right stock in the right market is worth more than either. Who is on the other side: traders who read one of the two and ignore the other.
why_it_might_not: Twenty-five pairs is already a search; a pair that passes only at one threshold is a peak, not a plateau; both-on samples are thin in some quarters (5 trades a side minimum); the single effects were small, so their sum may be too.

data.trades: gold/studies/E02-ANY_trades.parquet: 151,836 random liquid-stock entries 2000-2023 with the 20-session hold, net of costs (the null entry set, so the setups and states are the only information)
data.features: gold/features/daily: ret_20, ret_60, dist_sma20, dist_sma50, vol_ratio20, deliv_pct per stock-day
data.market: india.conditions.context_table / apply_market: Nifty vs its 200-day, breadth above the 200-day, India VIX, small-cap leadership, the breadth thrust

stock_setups.not_extended: close no more than 20% above the 50-day average and up no more than 25% in 20 sessions (plateau: 15/20 ; 20/25 ; 25/30)
stock_setups.pull_healthy: 5-12% under the 20-day average, above the 50-day, volume under its 20-day average (plateau: volume under 0.9 / 1.0 / 1.2 x)

market_states.nifty_gt200d: Nifty 50 above its 200-day average on the signal day
market_states.breadth_lt30: under 30% of the liquid universe above its 200-day
market_states.small_lead: Nifty Smallcap 100 / Nifty 100 above its 50-day average
market_states.breadth_thrust: share above the 200-day up 20 points in 10 sessions

definitions.interaction: v2 (30 Oct, before any conclusion was drawn; the v1 'both minus the larger single' was biased downward and the control showed it): per calendar quarter, mean net 20-session return of trades with both on, minus the mean of trades with the market state on and the setup off (the setup's added value given the state); quarters with fewer than 5 trades in either group are skipped; the state's added value given the setup (both minus setup-on-state-off) is reported beside it and the shortlist needs both positive in validation
definitions.plateau: the interaction re-computed at the loose and the tight threshold of the stock setup; a pair 'holds on a plateau' when the validation-period interaction is positive at all three settings (reported in extra, not part of the verdict)
definitions.consistency: share of calendar years (with at least 10 both-on trades) in which the both-on mean beat the state-alone mean (reported)
definitions.control: for each market state, a random stock flag drawn once with a fixed seed at the base setup's frequency (about the share of trades flagged by not_extended), paired the same way: expected 0

statistics.blocks: calendar quarters; t across quarters of the interaction
statistics.verdict: india/registry.record standard rule; 16 blocks per period; expected +1 for every pair, 0 for the controls
statistics.trial_penalty: the family bar is over all 30 variants (k frozen at 30), so each pair pays for the 29 others tried

bar.note: a new family: 25 pairs plus 5 controls; k frozen at 30

rating: a pair is rated for a 20-session paper trial only if its verdict is VALIDATED or CONDITIONAL, it holds on the plateau, both added values are positive in validation, and its consistency is at least 60%; the top pairs by validation t among those (at most 10) are the shortlist
not_claimed: A shortlisted pair goes to a 20-session paper trial (a filter on the existing campaigns, never a new book) and then to Madhav's yes; nothing here changes a rule. The lab is bounded by design: no further pairs or thresholds will be added to this version.
